top_matches.text: As for the aspersions the world Zionist organization is casting on our country and your own statement on the position of Jews in the Soviet Union, I’d like to tell you this: spare your energy, no one will go to your paradise!

We cannot even imagine living in a country that commits aggression against the neighbouring peoples and makes a living from the sops it receives from the imperialist sharks, the leaders of international Zionism.

It is with excruciating pain that we hear about the crimes of the Israeli aggressors who shoot at women and children, raze towns and burn down villages: we in Byelorussia lived through these horrors during the nazi invasion.
Are your provocations against the Arabs, the seizure of their land and property and the killing of civilians any different from nazi atrocities in the occupied territories?

The persistent and impertinent claims of Zionist radio saboteurs, who provocatively allege that almost all the two million Soviet Jews dream of nothing other than emigrating to Israel, and that the remaining 2 million citizens of the Soviet Union “oppress” and “persecute” them, provoke the indignation of the Soviet people.
top_matches.source: Zionism: Enemy of Peace and Social Progress

top_matches.text: The rabid clique ruling the roost in the state of Israel, has turned the country into an instrument of imperialism, an instrument of aggression against the freedom-loving Arab peoples.

Golda Meir and her fascist-like friends have committed evil deeds of the type committed by the Hitlerite murderers. We shall never be able to forget the horrors of war. We paid dearly for our victory.

We representatives of the older generation of Soviet doctors of Jewish nationality, who, together with all the peoples of our united multinational country, took an active part in the Great Patriotic War against fascism, are indignant at the provocative calls of the Israeli Government for us to leave our socialist country where we are fullfledged citizens, and active builders of communism.

Israel must stop its policy of annexation and extermination of the peaceful inhabitants of Arab countries. The annexationist ambitions of Zionists backed by US imperialist circles are opposed to the interests of Israeli working people and can only bring them misfortune.” E.

It was our misfortune that broad sections of the population lost their sense of human dignity and justice and followed Hitler because he promised them a good dinner and supper at the expense of other peoples as a result of war and plunder." [43] The total Zionisation of Israel, further military adventures for the sake of the international Zionist concern and its imperialist allies, adventures pregnant with the most dire consequences, and the search for "living space" is one road.
